title: Fix TypeScript compilation errors in security module
body:
CI build failing with 26 TypeScript errors in `packages/core/src/security/`. Root causes: interface/class name collision, Zod 4.x API changes, incorrect logger signatures, and Node.js environment type checks.

## Changes

- **Duplicate export resolution**: Renamed `PluginConfigValidator` interface to `IPluginConfigValidator` in `plugin-loader.ts` (class with same name exported from `security/`)

- **Zod 4.x compatibility**: Changed `ZodError.errors` → `ZodError.issues`, added type parameter `ZodError<any>` for property access

- **Logger signature fix**: Updated `logger.error(message, metadata)` → `logger.error(message, undefined, metadata)` to match 3-parameter signature `(message, error?, meta?)`

- **Environment type guards**: Changed `typeof window` → `typeof (globalThis as any).window` to avoid Node.js compilation errors

- **Test fixtures**: 
  - Fixed relative import paths in `security/` subdirectory tests
  - Changed unsupported log level `'silent'` → `'error'`
  - Added required `certified: false` field to `PluginCapability` test objects
  - Fixed `getService` mock to use generic type parameter

```typescript
// Before
logger.error(errorMessage, { plugin: plugin.name, errors });

// After  
logger.error(errorMessage, undefined, { plugin: plugin.name, errors });
```

```typescript
// Before
return error.errors.map(e => ({ ... }));

// After
return error.issues.map((e: z.ZodIssue) => ({ ... }));
```
